findings.fix: Optionally say in the intent that only the bridge messenger can call this.

couldNotCheck: The L1StandardBridge implementation behind L1ChugSplashProxy 0x697402166fbf2f22e970df8a6486ef171dbfc524 is not in the directory. meta.json proxyResolution has isProxy false and no implementations, and _doProxyCall delegatecalls to an address read from the PROXY_IMPLEMENTATION_ADDRESS slot. So none of the bridge logic (burn vs lock, token pair checks, fees, onlyOtherBridge, the finalizeBridgeETH msg.value/_amount rule) could be read from code.
